title: 防災工学Ⅰ
subtitle: Disaster Prevention Engineering I
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) gain basic knowledge concerning maintenance of infrastructures, to keep them safe in a sustainable manner. (2) learn maintenance methods for concrete structures.
advice: This is a basic course on the maintenance of infrastructures. We will cover the following topics: 1. Maintenance systems 2. Life cycle design 3. Deterioration mechanisms and countermeasures for concrete (chloride attack, carbonation, ASR, frost damage) Students are required to actively participate in class. Students are expected to bring their textbook and other necessary materials to every class. This is useful preparation for Civil and Environmental Engineering Major Lab/Exercises.
books: [Textbook] Maintenance Engineering for Infrastructures ISBN:978-4-8106-0858-8 [Reserved book] Recommendation of inspection for infrastructures ISBN:978-4906857500
requiredKnowledge: Students must have knowledge of Environmental Materials and Reinforced Concrete. They must also be acquainted with density and the concentration of a solution.
